_about: V68: lock-on camera pose multipliers on the V3 closed form (CameraRig.cs). heightMul < 1 lowers the camera = lower pitch (V3 pose ~22 deg down at 4 m gap), so the horizon, eclipse and ruins rise in the frame. backMul pulls back, lookYAdd raises the look-at, shoulder = sideways offset in m. 1,1,0,1 = the old pose.

zone._about: CAMZONE v1 (CamZone.cs, zones only, ZoneRuntime.Owns): the lock target must be an enemy FIGHTING Joan (not giving up / walking home), alive, and within targetMaxGapM (kept to targetReleaseGapM); else the nearest fighting enemy, else the free camera. A change by ZoneRuntime is held minHoldS. A corpse goes to a living fighter at once, else the death camera keeps it until Joan is deathReleaseGapM away or deathReleaseS passed. gapCapM caps the gap the pose back / height formula uses (v108b: height 6.3-8.6 m at 9-12 m). yawMaxDegPerS caps the lock yaw turn. freePitchDeg = the free camera pitch while locked, freePitchMaxDeg = its ceiling (no 60 deg birds eye from a mouse drift), xClamp = the camera x clamp in zones (arena 11.5), yieldMaxS = release a finisher yield that never ended. enabled=false or zones off = the v108b camera.

freeCam._about: FREECAM v1 (CameraRig.cs, the free camera = lock off, after a fight / in the camp; the LOCK camera is not read from here): distance = metres behind the focus, height = focus height above Joan's feet (m), shoulder = sideways offset of the focus (m, + = camera to the right, Joan on the left of the frame), startPitchDeg = pitch applied once at the first free frame (the zone free pitch after a lock is camera_pose.json zone.freePitchDeg 8, the scene started at 2), vertical FOV = lockCam.fovFree. After a fight (CamZone lets the corpse go, rig.enemy = none) the camera used to JUMP from the death-camera pose to the free pose and kept the death-camera lens (FOV 38, camera_death.json fov) for good: catchRate = 1/s decay of the position offset, fovEaseS = seconds for the lens to return to lockCam.fovFree. Collision (camera_collision.json radius / layers / minDistFromTarget unchanged): ignoreSelf = the player's own colliders do not count, a hit pulls in at once, release = colReleaseMPerS m/s after colHoldS s without a hit. enabled=false = the old free camera (3.3 / 1.6 / 0.5, instant collision) exactly. Old values: distance 3.3, height 1.6, shoulder 0.5 (public fields of CameraRig, scene start pitch 2).

lockCam._about: HCKIT1 v93 K3: the V3 lock-camera closed form (CameraRig.cs). back = (max(backMin, backPerM*d + backAdd) + foe*foe.back) * backOuter * backMul; height = (max(heightMin, heightPerM*d) * heightScale + foe*foe.height) * heightOuter * heightMul. d = player-enemy gap (floor gapMin). foe = (enemyHeightM - foe.refHeightM) / foe.refHeightM, floored at 0; enemyHeightM = roster.json heightM of the enemy when > 0 (foe.useRosterHeight), else lossyScale.y * foe.scaleToM (today Pitborn: scale -> 2.5 m). blendRate = 1/s of the pose ease, lookUp / lookAhead = look-at offsets (m), xClamp = |camera x| limit, fovFree / fovLock = vertical FOV at lock weight 0 / 1, fallbackPos / fallbackLook = first-frame safety pose. All values = the old inline literals.
